name: pulse-ports
description: Holds commands that would start a dev server on a port you keep for your own testing, and offers a free port instead.

reservedPorts.title: Reserved ports
reservedPorts.description: Ports you keep for your own testing, as a comma list (3000, 8080). A command that would start a server on one of them is held.

checkPackageJson.title: Reserve package.json ports
checkPackageJson.description: on: the ports the nearest package.json scripts would serve on (--port, -p, PORT=, vite.config server.port, framework defaults) are reserved too. off: only the reservedPorts list is.

firstFreePort.title: First free port
firstFreePort.description: Where the search for a free port starts. The first port from here up that is not reserved and has no listener is offered.
